# Adjudication Task — Chapter 32

## Korean source

```text
  1|＃32화
  2|
  3|
  4|
  5|“이틀 전 큰 전투가 있었습니다. 혼주(昏住)에서 본가의 정예 일백과 항산검문의 선봉 이백이 맞붙었죠.”
  6|
  7|“전투가 있었다고요?”
  8|
  9|심지어 수백 명이 투입된 큰 전투란다. 순간 가슴이 덜컥했지만 앞서 위팽이 했던 말이 생각났다.
 10|
 11|좋은 소식과 더 좋은 소식. 결과는 이미 들은 셈이다.
 12|
 13|“우리가 이겼군요.”
 14|
 15|“대승입니다. 살아서 도망친 놈들은 서른이 채 되지 않습니다. 본가의 사상자 숫자와 비슷하죠.”
 16|
 17|위팽의 이마부터 턱까지 그어진 상처를 보건대 상당히 격렬한 전투였던 모양이다.
 18|
 19|‘하긴. 병력 차이가 두 배나 났으니까.’
 20|
 21|아무튼 이겨서 다행이다. 태원진가 입장에서는 가문의 전력을 절반 가까이 쏟아부은 전투. 만약 졌다면 타격이 막대했을 것이다.
 22|
 23|“항산검문의 소가주를 놓친 건 아쉽지만 항산쌍귀(恒山雙鬼)를 잡은 건 큰 수확입니다.”
 24|
 25|“항산썅귀요?”
 26|
 27|“항산쌍귀 말입니다. 항산검문 휘하의 절정 고수들인데…… 충성심 하나는 대단하더군요. 목숨을 도외시하고 덤비는 통에 어쩔 수 없이 죽였죠.”
 28|
 29|위팽이 새로 생긴 상처를 톡톡 건드렸다.
 30|
 31|“붙잡았다면 중요한 정보를 캐낼 수 있었을 텐데.”
 32|
 33|“그쪽이, 아니 위 대협이 죽였나요?”
 34|
 35|“주군과 제가 한 놈씩 맡았습니다. 제법이더군요.”
 36|
 37|“…….”
 38|
 39|호로록, 차를 들이켜는 위팽의 모습에 할 말을 잃었다.
 40|
 41|‘이런 씨바…… 절정 고수가 장난이야?’
 42|
 43|내 27년 인생을 통틀어 가장 치열한 싸움이었다. 온갖 내상에 스테이크처럼 칼질도 당했다. 그러고도 닷새 동안 뻗어 있었으니 요단강에서 반신욕 정도는 한 거다.
 44|
 45|그런데 그 정도의 절정 고수를 잡아 놓고. 뭐, 제법이라고?
 46|
 47|‘이건 완전히 괴물이잖아.’
 48|
 49|이번 기회에 확실히 알았다. 절정 고수에도 급이 있다는 사실을. 그 정도의 고수들이 내 편이라는 게 천만다행이다.
 50|
 51|“그건 그렇고.”
 52|
 53|달그락.
 54|
 55|찻잔을 내려놓은 위팽이 미묘한 눈빛으로 나를 응시했다.
 56|
 57|“대단하시더군요.”
 58|
 59|“예?”
 60|
 61|“일문일살 조필 말입니다. 그를 해치운 건 대단하다는 말로도 표현이 불가능한 일입니다.”
 62|
 63|“…….”
 64|
 65|난 당신들이 더 대단해 보이는데. 이건 마치 A급 헌터에게 고블린 잘 잡는다고 칭찬받은 기분이다.
 66|
 67|“아, 예. 뭐 감사합니다.”
 68|
 69|조필에 관한 이야기는 이쯤에서 마무리 짓고 싶었다. 몸 상태도, 기분도 별로인 데다 밀려 있는 시스템 보상을 확인하고 싶었기 때문이다.
 70|
 71|‘이제 좀 쉬자. 나 아직 환자야, 인마.’
 72|
 73|그런 의미를 담아 윙크를 날리자 위팽이 눈살을 찌푸렸다.
 74|
 75|“눈이 아프십니까? 의원을 부를까요?”
 76|
 77|“……아뇨. 괜찮아요.”
 78|
 79|“방금 눈 쪽에 경련이 일어났는데요.”
 80|
 81|“그건 경련이 아닌데요.”
 82|
 83|“맞습니다, 경련. 제대로 봤습니다.”
 84|
 85|“아니, 방금 그건…….”
 86|
 87|그때 위팽이 눈깔을 허옇게 뒤집고 부르르 떨었다.
 88|
 89|탁자가 흔들리고 잔에서 찻물이 흘러넘쳤다. 나는 깜짝 놀라 외쳤다.
 90|
 91|“세상에, 위 대협!”
 92|
 93|이 인간 간질 환자구나. 아니, 무슨 절정 고수씩이나 되는 양반이 간질에 걸렸대?
 94|
 95|내가 황급히 일어나려 할 때 떨림이 멈췄다. 정상으로 돌아온 위팽이 평온한 얼굴로 말했다.
 96|
 97|“이러셨습니다.”
 98|
 99|“괜찮으시…… 아니, 예?”
100|
101|“삼공자께서 방금 이러셨다고요. 눈에 경련이 일어났어요.”
102|
103|“그러니까. 절 따라 하신 거라고요?”
104|
105|“예.”
106|
107|아니, 이건 무슨 종류의 또라이야…….
108|
109|나는 윙크와 간질의 차이를 설명해 주려 했지만, 말문이 막혔다. 위팽이 열받은 독재자처럼 나를 노려보는 중이었다.
110|
111|“……그냥 조필 얘기나 마저 할까요?”
112|
113|“그러시죠.”
114|
115|위팽이 만족스럽게 고개를 끄덕였다.
116|
117|‘또라이 새끼.’
118|
119|결국 나는 조필과의 싸움을 처음부터 끝까지 털어놔야 했다.
120|
121|그가 어떻게 움직였고 무슨 무공을 썼는지. 위팽의 날카로운 질문 때문에 긴장되는 순간도 있었다.
122|
123|“비수로 조필의 다리 근맥을 끊으셨다고요?”
124|
125|“네. 미리 숨겨 둔 거였죠.”
126|
127|“조필이 그걸 못 알아차렸을 리가 없는데…… 계속하십시오.”
128|
129|마침내 긴 이야기가 끝났을 때, 위팽은 참았던 숨을 토해 냈다. 나를 바라보는 눈빛에 복잡한 심정이 그대로 전해진다.
130|
131|“삼공자. 실로 큰 공을 세우셨습니다.”
132|
133|“아, 감사합니…….”
134|
135|“인정하긴 싫지만 진심입니다.”
136|
137|“……아, 예.”
138|
139|“지금껏 사고 치신 걸 생각하면 피가 거꾸로 솟지만 정말 감탄했습니다. 진심입니다.”
140|
141|“…….”
142|
143|“누가 생각이나 했겠습니까. 허구한 날 가문 공금 훔쳐서 주루에 갖다 바치고, 술에 떡이 돼서 거리를 활보하며 가문 명성에 똥칠을 하던 삼공자께서 이리 큰사람이 되실 줄이야. 이 위팽, 진심으로 탄복했습니다.”
144|
145|차라리 욕을 해, 이 새끼야…….
146|
147|나는 튀어나오려는 쌍욕을 간신히 참으며 말했다.
148|
149|“운이 좋았죠. 조필이 방심한 것도 있고요.”
150|
151|위팽이 고개를 저었다.
152|
153|“아닙니다. 전부 실력입니다. 누가 방심했고 비수를 숨겨 뒀느냐는 핑계가 되지 못합니다. 고작 그 정도로 조필을 죽일 수 있었다면 그는 일문일살 조필이 아니었을 겁니다. 무림은 강한 자만이 살아남는 곳이니까요.”
154|
155|“강한 자만이 살아남는다.”
156|
157|그 말을 조용히 혀끝에서 굴렸다. 어딘지 모르게 쓰고 달콤하다.
158|
159|무림은, 이 게임은 처음부터 그런 곳이었다. 나는 그런 곳에서 살아남았고, 강해진 것이다.
160|
161|“조필은 전심무공을 모두 발휘했습니다. 마지막에는 선천지기까지 끌어올렸고요. 절정 고수가 스스로의 목숨을 버려 가며 공자를 죽이려 한 겁니다. 하지만 결과는 어떻습니까?”
162|
163|“제가 이겼죠.”
164|
165|“예. 바로 그겁니다.”
166|
167|“그럼 저는 조필보다 강했던 거군요.”
168|
169|아까부터 떨떠름하던 위팽이 정색을 하고 말했다.
170|
171|“무슨 소립니까. 조필이 더 강하죠. 절정 고수가 장난처럼 보이세요?”
172|
173|“…….”
174|
175|“기습으로 조필을 죽일 정도로만 강하신 겁니다.”
176|
177|적당히 해라, 진짜.
178|
179|인벤토리에서 무기를 꺼낼까 말까 고민하고 있을 때 위팽이 피식 웃었다. 처음 보는 그의 웃음이다.
180|
181|“잘하셨습니다.”
182|
183|나는 의심 어린 눈길로 위팽을 바라봤다.
184|
185|“이번엔 또 무슨 말을 덧붙이시려고?”
186|
187|웃음이 더욱 짙어졌다.
188|
189|“진심입니다. 제가 공자를 상당히 싫어했던 건 사실이지만…… 이번만큼은 인정하지 않을 도리가 없군요.”
190|
191|이렇게 나오면 할 말이 없다. 나는 왠지 모르게 민망해져서 헛기침을 내뱉었다.
192|
193|“크흠. 뭐 죽을 뻔하긴 했지만 겨우 조필이랑 낭인 몇 명 잡은 게 전부인데요. 크흠.”
194|
195|“한 성(城)에 절정 고수가 몇이나 있다고 생각하십니까? 본가가 위치한 산서를 통틀어도 채 스물이 되지 않습니다.”
196|
197|스물이라. 예상보다 훨씬 적은 숫자다.
198|
199|“항산검문 쪽 피해가 상당하겠네요. 그런 절정 고수를 셋이나 잃었으니.”
200|
201|“하지만 가장 큰 타격은 따로 있지요.”
202|
203|“그게 뭔데요?”
204|
205|“그건…….”
206|
207|위팽이 입을 연 그 순간이었다.
208|
209|“명분. 이 전쟁을 시작하게 된 명분이 사라진 거지. 태원진가의 삼공자는 독 따위를 쓰지 않아도 충분히 강하니까. 암, 그렇고말고.”
210|
211|문가에서 들려온 떨리는 목소리. 거구의 진위경이 울먹거리며 두 팔을 벌렸다.
212|
213|“막내야아아!”
214|
215|“…….”
216|
217|제발 나 좀 내버려 둬.
218|
219|
220|
221|* * *
222|
223|
224|
225|결국 나는 지난 며칠간의 추격전과 조필과의 일전을 다시 한번 반복 재생해야 했다.
226|
227|“그때 생존자들을 추적해 온 낭인들이…….”
228|
229|“이런 찢어 죽일 놈들!”
230|
231|쾅!
232|
233|“조필의 화염신장에 내상을…….”
234|
235|“죽일 놈! 악랄한 낭인 새끼가 감히! 오장육부를 뜯어내고 잘근잘근 씹어 먹어도 시원찮을 놈!”
236|
237|쾅쾅쾅!
238|
239|“…….”
240|
241|나는 멍한 얼굴로 초토화가 된 침실을 바라봤다. 진위경의 과한 몰입감이 불러온 결과였다.
242|
243|위팽은 진작 멀찍이 떨어져서 입을 벙긋거리고 있었다.
244|
245|- 그 얘기는 다시 안 하는 게 좋겠습니다.
246|
247|처음으로 우리 둘의 의견이 일치된 순간이었다.
248|
249|진위경은 한참을 씨근덕거리다가 안정을 되찾았…….
250|
251|“놈이 살아 있었다면 곱게 죽진 못했을 것이다.”
252|
253|콰드득. 나는 침대 모서리가 가루가 되어 흩날리는 광경을 슬픈 눈으로 지켜봤다. 위팽이 고개를 절레절레 흔들었다.
254|
255|“주군. 그만 진정하시지요. 공자께서 불안해하시는 것 같은데요.”
256|
257|이번 말은 확실히 효과가 있었다. 온몸에 붕대를 두른 채 슬픈 눈으로 앉아 있는 나를 본 진위경이 눈시울을 붉혔다.
258|
259|“우리 막내 좀 보게. 이 어린 녀석이 얼마나 고초를 겪었으면 이리 넋이 나가 있단 말인가.”
260|
261|덥석!
262|
263|솥뚜껑만 한 손이 어깨를 잡고 끌어당긴다. 나도 한 덩치 하는데 이 인간은 거의 소형 오우거급이다. 나는 그의 넓은 가슴에 안겨 두려움에 몸을 떨었다.
264|
265|“그래, 막내야. 이제 괜찮다. 괜찮아.”
266|
267|혼자만 감동적인 포옹을 끝낸 진위경이 코를 훌쩍였다.
268|
269|“언제까지 어린아이일 줄만 알았는데…… 이제 다 컸구나. 위팽, 그거 아는가?”
270|
271|위팽이 숨도 쉬지 않고 대답했다.
272|
273|“예. 말씀 안 해 주셔도 됩니다.”
274|
275|물론 진위경은 들은 척도 하지 않았다.
276|
277|“본가는 물론이고 저잣거리에까지 소문이 퍼지고 있네. 결사대를 이끌고 적진을 기습. 일문일살 조필과 일백의 낭인들을 쓰러트리고 삭주 지부의 식솔들을 구출해 낸 영웅의 이야기 말일세.”
278|
279|“와. 그거 대단…… 예?”
280|
281|나는 눈을 깜빡였다. 잠깐만. 저게 내 이야기였어?
282|
283|“저기, 뭔가 오해가 있는 것 같은데요.”
284|
285|“맞습니다. 주군. 뭔가 오해가…….”
286|
287|진위경은 흐뭇하게 웃었다.
288|
289|“우리 막내, 겸손하기도 하지. 위팽 자네는 입 닥치게.”
290|
291|“아뇨, 겸손이 아니라 소문이 좀 왜곡된 것 같은데.”
292|
293|“맞습니다. 주군이 공자를 아끼시는 건 알지만 이건 너무 나가셨습니다. 소문이 너무 허황되면 사람들이 믿지 않을…….”
294|
295|“소문? 허황?”
296|
297|콰광!
298|
299|위팽의 목소리는 굉음에 파묻혀 사라졌다. 나는 뻥 뚫린 침실 벽면을 바라보며 입을 딱 벌렸다.
300|
301|‘뭔 짓거리야. 미친놈아.’
302|
303|진위경이 다시 한번 주먹을 뻗었다. 압축된 공기가 터져 나가는 소리와 함께 그나마 남아 있던 벽이 무너져 내렸다.
304|
305|이 층짜리 전각에서 나무와 벽돌이 쏟아져 내리니 밖에 있던 사람들이 아우성을 쳤다.
306|
307|“삼공자다! 삼공차 처소가 무너지고 있다!”

“No. It was all skill. It makes no difference who let their guard down or who hid a dagger in advance. If that alone had been enough to kill Jopil, he would never have been Jopil, One Question, One Kill. Murim is a place where only the strong survive.”

[P78]
“Only the strong survive.”

[P79]
I quietly rolled the words over my tongue. They tasted somehow bitter and sweet at once.

[P80]
Murim—this game—had been that kind of place from the beginning. I had survived there, and I had grown stronger.

[P81]
“Jopil used every martial art at his disposal to its fullest. In the end, he even drew upon his innate qi. A Peak master threw away his own life in an attempt to kill you. But what was the result?”

[P82]
“I won.”

[P83]
“Yes. Exactly.”

[P84]
“Then I was stronger than Jopil.”

[P85]
Wipeng, who had looked vaguely displeased all this time, suddenly turned dead serious.

[P86]
“What are you talking about? Jopil was stronger. Do Peak masters look like a joke to you?”

[P87]
“…”

[P88]
“You were only strong enough to kill Jopil with a surprise attack.”

[P89]
*Enough already. Seriously.*

[P90]

[P91]
“Well done.”

[P92]
I eyed him suspiciously.

[P93]
“What are you going to add this time?”

[P94]
His smile deepened.

[P95]
“I mean it. It’s true that I disliked you considerably, but… this time, I have no choice but to acknowledge what you’ve done.”

[P96]
When he put it that way, I had nothing to say. For some reason, I felt embarrassed and cleared my throat.

[P97]
“Ahem. Well, I nearly died, but all I really did was take down Jopil and a few wandering martial artists. Ahem.”

[P98]
“How many Peak masters do you think there are in a single province? Even across all of Shanxi, where our family is based, there are fewer than twenty.”

[P99]
Twenty. Far fewer than I’d expected.

[P100]
“The Mount Heng Sword Sect must have taken serious losses. They lost three Peak masters.”

[P101]
“But the greatest blow lies elsewhere.”

[P102]
“What is it?”

[P103]
“That would be…”

[P104]
The instant Wipeng opened his mouth, a trembling voice came from the doorway.

[P105]
“Their pretext. They’ve lost the pretext they used to start this war. The Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan is more than strong enough without resorting to poison. Yes, indeed.”

[P106]
The enormous Jin Wikyung stood in the doorway, teary-eyed and holding both arms wide open.

[P107]
“My youngest!”

[P108]
“…”

[P109]
*Please, just leave me alone.*

[P110]
* * *

[P111]
In the end, I had to replay the chase of the past several days and my battle with Jopil all over again.

[P112]
“The wandering martial artists who pursued the survivors…”

[P113]
“Those bastards! I’ll tear them apart!”

[P114]
*Boom!*

[P115]
“Jopil’s Flame Divine Palm left me with internal injuries…”

[P116]
“I’ll kill him! How dare that vicious wandering martial artist bastard! Even ripping out his guts and chewing them to pieces wouldn’t be enough!”

[P117]
*Boom! Boom! Boom!*

[P118]
“…”

[P119]
I stared blankly at the ruins of my bedroom. This was what Jin Wikyung’s excessive immersion in the story had wrought.

[P120]
Wipeng had already retreated to a safe distance and was mouthing something.

[P121]
—We should never tell that story again.

[P122]
For the first time, the two of us were in complete agreement.

[P123]
Jin Wikyung huffed and puffed for a long while before finally calming dow—

[P124]
“If that bastard were still alive, I wouldn’t have let him die peacefully.”

[P125]
*Crunch.*

[P126]
I watched sadly as the corner of the bed crumbled into powder. Wipeng shook his head.

[P127]
“My lord, please calm down. The Young Master appears to be frightened.”

[P128]
That actually worked. Jin Wikyung’s eyes reddened when he saw me sitting there in a daze, wrapped from head to toe in bandages.

[P129]
“Just look at my youngest. How much must this poor child have suffered to be sitting there so completely out of it?”

[P130]
*Grab!*

[P131]
A hand the size of a cauldron lid clamped onto my shoulder and pulled me in. I was a fairly big guy myself, but this man was practically a small ogre. Trapped against his broad chest, I trembled in fear.

[P132]
“There, my youngest. It’s all right now. Everything’s all right.”

[P133]
After ending a heartfelt embrace that only he found moving, Jin Wikyung sniffed.

[P134]
“I thought you would always be a child… but you’ve grown up now. Wipeng, do you know something?”

[P135]
Wipeng answered without even pausing to breathe.

[P136]
“Yes. You don’t need to tell me.”

[P137]
Of course, Jin Wikyung pretended not to hear him.

[P138]
“Word has spread throughout our family and even into the marketplace. The tale of the hero who led a death squad in a raid on the enemy camp, defeated Jopil, One Question, One Kill, and a hundred wandering martial artists, and rescued the people of the Sakju Branch.”

[P139]
“Wow. That’s amaz—wait, what?”

[P140]
I blinked.

[P141]
*Hold on. That was supposed to be me?*

[P142]
“Um, I think there’s been some kind of misunderstanding.”

[P143]
“That’s right, my lord. There seems to have been some misunder—”

[P144]
Jin Wikyung smiled with satisfaction.

[P145]
“My youngest is modest too. Wipeng, shut your mouth.”

[P146]
“No, I’m not being modest. I think the rumor has been distorted.”

[P147]
“That’s right. I know how much you care for the Young Master, my lord, but this has gone too far. If the rumor becomes too outlandish, no one will beli—”

[P148]
“Rumor? Outlandish?”

[P149]
*BOOM!*

[P150]
Wipeng’s voice vanished beneath a thunderous crash. My mouth fell open as I stared at the gaping hole in my bedroom wall.

[P151]
*What the hell are you doing, you lunatic?*

[P152]
Jin Wikyung threw another punch. Compressed air exploded, and what remained of the wall collapsed.

[P153]
Wood and bricks poured from the two-story pavilion, sending the people outside into an uproar.

[P154]
“It’s the Third Young Master! The Third Young Master’s residence is collapsing!”

[P155]
“Get people over here! Hurry!”

[P156]
While everyone was still reeling in shock, Jin Wikyung hoisted me into the air.

[P157]
*Put me down. Put me down, you crazy bastard!*

[P158]
I struggled with all my strength, but I couldn’t fight him off. One step at a time, he carried me toward the gaping hole in the wall, and terror mounted with every step.

[P159]
*He’s going to drop me!*

[P160]
More than fifty people had gathered below. They called it a two-story building, but the pavilion was so large that we had to be a good ten meters up. The wind gusting through the hole made me dizzy.

[P161]
*If I fall, I’ll break something at the very least.*

[P162]
Even as a chill ran down my spine, more people kept crowding in. Over fifty of them craned their necks to stare up at us.

[P163]
“Who’s that? Wasn’t there an accident?”

[P164]
“Isn’t that the Lesser Family Head? Who’s he holding?”

[P165]
“The Third Young Master! It’s the Third Young Master!”

[P166]
Someone’s shout sent a stir through the crowd.

[P167]
“The Third Young Master—no, the Third Young Master, sir?”

[P168]
“The Third Young Master who defeated Jopil, One Question, One Kill, has awakened!”

[P169]
*What the hell is going on?*

[P170]
As I frantically looked around, trying to make sense of the scene, a solemn voice rang clearly in my ear.

[P171]
“Can you see them?”

[P172]
“Ah, yes. I can see them. Could you put me down—”

[P173]
“Can you hear them?”

[P174]
“I can hear them too, but first, could you—”

[P175]
“What do you feel?”

[P176]
“Embarrassment. And shame.”

[P177]
“They believe in you. They’re calling your name!”

[P178]
“You fucking bastard.”

[P179]
My final curse vanished beneath the crowd’s shouts.

[P180]
“Third Young Master! Third Young Master!”

[P181]
Dozens more people had appeared in that brief span of time. Countless gazes flew toward me and pinned me in place.

[P182]
*No, what the hell is this?*

[P183]
Then Jin Wikyung, his expression grave, slid his hands beneath my armpits and lifted me high.

[P184]
Right on cue, a thunderous cheer erupted.

[P185]
“Woooooo!”

[P186]
“Third Young Master! Jin Taekyung!”

[P187]
“Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi! Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi!”

[P188]
And then…

[P189]
*Fuck. What am I, a baby lion?*

[P190]
The theme music from an old cartoon began playing in my head.

# Translation Rules

## Fidelity

- Translate the Korean source—not the wiki, manhwa, fan translations, or expected plot.
- Semantic fidelity outranks elegance. Never improve rhythm, humor, or localization by changing a physical action, negation, relationship, hierarchy, mechanism, quantity, or causal detail.

- Preserve small action verbs and pragmatic cues exactly: nodding versus shaking one's head, pretending nothing happened, and mild or approachable impressions are characterization, not expendable texture.
- Preserve viewpoint and tense. Resolve omitted subjects only when context supports it; retain genuine ambiguity.
- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.
- Search only exact Korean terms already present in the current chapter; the compendium contains future-sensitive entries.

- In System panels, render `등급` as `**Grade:**` for quest, item, skill, and martial-art classifications. Reserve `rank` for Hunter classifications or ordinary prose; never replace a System `Grade` field with `Rank`.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.
- Keep the final file English-only reading copy: no audit notes, Korean text, summaries, or model metadata.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
- Jin Taekyung’s narration is conversational, observant, self-mocking, and occasionally profane. It may be irreverent even when the situation is serious.
- Keep deadpan punchlines short and well-timed. Do not explain a joke after delivering it.
- Preserve the source's level of explicitness. A euphemism may remain euphemistic even when its meaning is sexual or crude; do not replace it with more graphic English merely for impact.
- Make dialogue spontaneous and character-specific. Preserve hierarchy and intimacy through word choice, address, rhythm, and restraint—not archaic wuxia English.
- Use strong profanity when the Korean is strong, but neither intensify nor sanitize it. Do not make ordinary lines uniformly vulgar. Profanity should reveal mood or relationship.
- Keep action and injury vivid but clear rather than purple. Do not make violence funny unless the source’s framing does.
- Avoid stiff literalism, translator-added melodrama, dated internet slang, and quippy superhero-style banter.

“I got lucky. Jopil let his guard down too.”

[P76]
Wipeng shook his head.

[P77]
“No. It was all skill. It makes no difference who let their guard down or who hid a dagger in advance. If that alone had been enough to kill Jopil, he would never have been Jopil, One Question, One Kill. Murim is a place where only the strong survive.”

[P78]
“Only the strong survive.”

[P79]
I quietly rolled the words over my tongue. They tasted somehow bitter and sweet at once.

[P80]
Murim—this game—had been that kind of place from the beginning. I had survived there, and I had grown stronger.

[P81]
“Jopil used every martial art at his disposal to its fullest. In the end, he even drew upon his innate qi. A Peak master threw away his own life in an attempt to kill you. But what was the result?”

[P82]
“I won.”

[P83]
“Yes. Exactly.”

[P84]
“Then I was stronger than Jopil.”

[P85]
Wipeng, who had looked vaguely displeased all this time, suddenly turned dead serious.

[P86]
“What are you talking about? Jopil was stronger. Do Peak masters look like a joke to you?”

[P87]
“…”

[P88]
“You were only strong enough to kill Jopil with a surprise attack.”

[P89]
*Enough already. Seriously.*

[P90]

[P91]
“Well done.”

[P92]
I eyed him suspiciously.

[P93]
“What are you going to add this time?”

[P94]
His smile deepened.

[P95]
“I mean it. It’s true that I disliked you considerably, but… this time, I have no choice but to acknowledge what you’ve done.”

[P96]
When he put it that way, I had nothing to say. For some reason, I felt embarrassed and cleared my throat.

[P97]
“Ahem. Well, I nearly died, but all I really did was take down Jopil and a few wandering martial artists. Ahem.”

[P98]
“How many Peak masters do you think there are in a single province? Even across all of Shanxi, where our family is based, there are fewer than twenty.”

[P99]
Twenty. Far fewer than I’d expected.

[P100]
“The Mount Heng Sword Sect must have taken serious losses. They lost three Peak masters.”

[P101]
“But the greatest blow lies elsewhere.”

[P102]
“What is it?”

[P103]
“That would be…”

[P104]
The instant Wipeng opened his mouth, a trembling voice came from the doorway.

[P105]
“Their pretext. They’ve lost the pretext they used to start this war. The Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan is more than strong enough without resorting to poison. Yes, indeed.”

[P106]
The enormous Jin Wikyung stood in the doorway, teary-eyed and holding both arms wide open.

[P107]
“My youngest!”

[P108]
“…”

[P109]
*Please, just leave me alone.*

[P110]
* * *

[P111]
In the end, I had to replay the chase of the past several days and my battle with Jopil all over again.

[P112]
“The wandering martial artists who pursued the survivors…”

[P113]
“Those bastards! I’ll tear them apart!”

[P114]
*Boom!*

[P115]
“Jopil’s Flame Divine Palm left me with internal injuries…”

[P116]
“I’ll kill him! How dare that vicious wandering martial artist bastard! Even ripping out his guts and chewing them to pieces wouldn’t be enough!”

[P117]
*Boom! Boom! Boom!*

[P118]
“…”

[P119]
I stared blankly at the ruins of my bedroom. This was what Jin Wikyung’s excessive immersion in the story had wrought.

[P120]
Wipeng had already retreated to a safe distance and was mouthing something.

[P121]
—We should never tell that story again.

[P122]
For the first time, the two of us were in complete agreement.

[P123]
Jin Wikyung huffed and puffed for a long while before finally calming dow—

[P124]
“If that bastard were still alive, I wouldn’t have let him die peacefully.”

[P125]
*Crunch.*

[P126]
I watched sadly as the corner of the bed crumbled into powder. Wipeng shook his head.

[P127]
“My lord, please calm down. The Young Master appears to be frightened.”

[P128]
That actually worked. Jin Wikyung’s eyes reddened when he saw me sitting there in a daze, wrapped from head to toe in bandages.

[P129]
“Just look at my youngest. How much must this poor child have suffered to be sitting there so completely out of it?”

[P130]
*Grab!*

[P131]
A hand the size of a cauldron lid clamped onto my shoulder and pulled me in. I was a fairly big guy myself, but this man was practically a small ogre. Trapped against his broad chest, I trembled in fear.

[P132]
“There, my youngest. It’s all right now. Everything’s all right.”

[P133]
After ending a heartfelt embrace that only he found moving, Jin Wikyung sniffed.

[P134]
“I thought you would always be a child… but you’ve grown up now. Wipeng, do you know something?”

[P135]
Wipeng answered without even pausing to breathe.

[P136]
“Yes. You don’t need to tell me.”

[P137]
Of course, Jin Wikyung pretended not to hear him.

[P138]
“Word has spread throughout our family and even into the marketplace. The tale of the hero who led a death squad in a raid on the enemy camp, defeated Jopil, One Question, One Kill, and a hundred wandering martial artists, and rescued the people of the Sakju Branch.”

[P139]
“Wow. That’s amaz—wait, what?”

[P140]
I blinked.

[P141]
*Hold on. That was supposed to be me?*

[P142]
“Um, I think there’s been some kind of misunderstanding.”

[P143]
“That’s right, my lord. There seems to have been some misunder—”

[P144]
Jin Wikyung smiled with satisfaction.

[P145]
“My youngest is modest too. Wipeng, shut your mouth.”

[P146]
“No, I’m not being modest. I think the rumor has been distorted.”

[P147]
“That’s right. I know how much you care for the Young Master, my lord, but this has gone too far. If the rumor becomes too outlandish, no one will beli—”

[P148]
“Rumor? Outlandish?”

[P149]
*BOOM!*

[P150]
Wipeng’s voice vanished beneath a thunderous crash. My mouth fell open as I stared at the gaping hole in my bedroom wall.

[P151]
*What the hell are you doing, you lunatic?*

[P152]
Jin Wikyung threw another punch. Compressed air exploded, and what remained of the wall collapsed.

[P153]
Wood and bricks poured from the two-story pavilion, sending the people outside into an uproar.

[P154]
“It’s the Third Young Master! The Third Young Master’s residence is collapsing!”

[P155]
“Get people over here! Hurry!”

[P156]
While everyone was still reeling in shock, Jin Wikyung hoisted me into the air.

[P157]
*Put me down. Put me down, you crazy bastard!*

[P158]
I struggled with all my strength, but I couldn’t fight him off. One step at a time, he carried me toward the gaping hole in the wall, and terror mounted with every step.

[P159]
*He’s going to drop me!*

[P160]
More than fifty people had gathered below. They called it a two-story building, but the pavilion was so large that we had to be a good ten meters up. The wind gusting through the hole made me dizzy.

[P161]
*If I fall, I’ll break something at the very least.*

[P162]
Even as a chill ran down my spine, more people kept crowding in. Over fifty of them craned their necks to stare up at us.

[P163]
“Who’s that? Wasn’t there an accident?”

[P164]
“Isn’t that the Lesser Family Head? Who’s he holding?”

[P165]
“The Third Young Master! It’s the Third Young Master!”

[P166]
Someone’s shout sent a stir through the crowd.

[P167]
“The Third Young Master—no, the Third Young Master, sir?”

[P168]
“The Third Young Master who defeated Jopil, One Question, One Kill, has awakened!”

[P169]
*What the hell is going on?*

[P170]
As I frantically looked around, trying to make sense of the scene, a solemn voice rang clearly in my ear.

[P171]
“Can you see them?”

[P172]
“Ah, yes. I can see them. Could you put me down—”

[P173]
“Can you hear them?”

[P174]
“I can hear them too, but first, could you—”

[P175]
“What do you feel?”

[P176]
“Embarrassment. And shame.”

[P177]
“They believe in you. They’re calling your name!”

[P178]
“You fucking bastard.”

[P179]
My final curse vanished beneath the crowd’s shouts.

[P180]
“Third Young Master! Third Young Master!”

[P181]
Dozens more people had appeared in that brief span of time. Countless gazes flew toward me and pinned me in place.

[P182]
*No, what the hell is this?*

[P183]
Then Jin Wikyung, his expression grave, slid his hands beneath my armpits and lifted me high.

[P184]
Right on cue, a thunderous cheer erupted.

[P185]
“Woooooo!”

[P186]
“Third Young Master! Jin Taekyung!”

[P187]
“Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi! Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi!”

[P188]
And then…

[P189]
*Fuck. What am I, a baby lion?*

[P190]
The theme music from an old cartoon began playing in my head.

# Translation Rules

## Fidelity

- Translate the Korean source—not the wiki, manhwa, fan translations, or expected plot.
- Semantic fidelity outranks elegance. Never improve rhythm, humor, or localization by changing a physical action, negation, relationship, hierarchy, mechanism, quantity, or causal detail.
- Preserve every fact, causal link, joke, emotional beat, repetition, and intentional omission. Add nothing.
- Preserve small action verbs and pragmatic cues exactly: nodding versus shaking one's head, pretending nothing happened, and mild or approachable impressions are characterization, not expendable texture.
- Preserve viewpoint and tense. Resolve omitted subjects only when context supports it; retain genuine ambiguity.
- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.
- Search only exact Korean terms already present in the current chapter; the compendium contains future-sensitive entries.
- Never re-romanize established names or invent grand names for uncertain terms. First use of an unlisted name or title almost always needs a footnote or a mapped ledger term.
- Use `qi` for Murim energy and `mana` for the modern Hunter system when the source distinguishes them. Preserve an established chapter-specific rendering such as `internal energy` when the exact glossary and surrounding Korean distinguish accumulated `공력` from resulting `기운`.
- In System panels, render `등급` as `**Grade:**` for quest, item, skill, and martial-art classifications. Reserve `rank` for Hunter classifications or ordinary prose; never replace a System `Grade` field with `Rank`.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.
- Keep the final file English-only reading copy: no audit notes, Korean text, summaries, or model metadata.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
- Jin Taekyung’s narration is conversational, observant, self-mocking, and occasionally profane. It may be irreverent even when the situation is serious.
- Keep deadpan punchlines short and well-timed. Do not explain a joke after delivering it.
- Preserve the source's level of explicitness. A euphemism may remain euphemistic even when its meaning is sexual or crude; do not replace it with more graphic English merely for impact.
- Make dialogue spontaneous and character-specific. Preserve hierarchy and intimacy through word choice, address, rhythm, and restraint—not archaic wuxia English.
- Use strong profanity when the Korean is strong, but neither intensify nor sanitize it. Do not make ordinary lines uniformly vulgar. Profanity should reveal mood or relationship.
- Keep action and injury vivid but clear rather than purple. Do not make violence funny unless the source’s framing does.
- Avoid stiff literalism, translator-added melodrama, dated internet slang, and quippy superhero-style banter.
- On the second pass, correct awkward English collocations and word choices without changing meaning or voice. Prefer ordinary, spoken English over stiff Latinate or ceremonial wording when the scene is brisk or comic: “goose bumps” rather than “gooseflesh,” and “laid into them” rather than “launched into a solemn denunciation.” Read the prose aloud and replace any phrase that sounds like a formal essay, legal document, or literal dictionary gloss unless the source deliberately calls for that register.

# Adjudication Task — Chapter 32

## Korean source

```text
  1|＃32화
  2|
  3|
  4|
  5|“이틀 전 큰 전투가 있었습니다. 혼주(昏住)에서 본가의 정예 일백과 항산검문의 선봉 이백이 맞붙었죠.”
  6|
  7|“전투가 있었다고요?”
  8|
  9|심지어 수백 명이 투입된 큰 전투란다. 순간 가슴이 덜컥했지만 앞서 위팽이 했던 말이 생각났다.
 10|
 11|좋은 소식과 더 좋은 소식. 결과는 이미 들은 셈이다.
 12|
 13|“우리가 이겼군요.”
 14|
 15|“대승입니다. 살아서 도망친 놈들은 서른이 채 되지 않습니다. 본가의 사상자 숫자와 비슷하죠.”
 16|
 17|위팽의 이마부터 턱까지 그어진 상처를 보건대 상당히 격렬한 전투였던 모양이다.
 18|
 19|‘하긴. 병력 차이가 두 배나 났으니까.’
 20|
 21|아무튼 이겨서 다행이다. 태원진가 입장에서는 가문의 전력을 절반 가까이 쏟아부은 전투. 만약 졌다면 타격이 막대했을 것이다.
 22|
 23|“항산검문의 소가주를 놓친 건 아쉽지만 항산쌍귀(恒山雙鬼)를 잡은 건 큰 수확입니다.”
 24|
 25|“항산썅귀요?”
 26|
 27|“항산쌍귀 말입니다. 항산검문 휘하의 절정 고수들인데…… 충성심 하나는 대단하더군요. 목숨을 도외시하고 덤비는 통에 어쩔 수 없이 죽였죠.”
 28|
 29|위팽이 새로 생긴 상처를 톡톡 건드렸다.
 30|
 31|“붙잡았다면 중요한 정보를 캐낼 수 있었을 텐데.”
 32|
 33|“그쪽이, 아니 위 대협이 죽였나요?”
 34|
 35|“주군과 제가 한 놈씩 맡았습니다. 제법이더군요.”
 36|
 37|“…….”
 38|
 39|호로록, 차를 들이켜는 위팽의 모습에 할 말을 잃었다.
 40|
 41|‘이런 씨바…… 절정 고수가 장난이야?’
 42|

“My lord, please calm down. The Young Master appears to be frightened.”

[P128]
That actually worked. Jin Wikyung’s eyes reddened when he saw me sitting there in a daze, wrapped from head to toe in bandages.

[P129]
“Just look at my youngest. How much must this poor child have suffered to be sitting there so completely out of it?”

[P130]
*Grab!*

[P131]
A hand the size of a cauldron lid clamped onto my shoulder and pulled me in. I was a fairly big guy myself, but this man was practically a small ogre. Trapped against his broad chest, I trembled in fear.

[P132]
“There, my youngest. It’s all right now. Everything’s all right.”

[P133]
After ending a heartfelt embrace that only he found moving, Jin Wikyung sniffed.

[P134]
“I thought you would always be a child… but you’ve grown up now. Wipeng, do you know something?”

[P135]
Wipeng answered without even pausing to breathe.

[P136]
“Yes. You don’t need to tell me.”

[P137]
Of course, Jin Wikyung pretended not to hear him.

[P138]
“Word has spread throughout our family and even into the marketplace. The tale of the hero who led a death squad in a raid on the enemy camp, defeated Jopil, One Question, One Kill, and a hundred wandering martial artists, and rescued the people of the Sakju Branch.”

[P139]
“Wow. That’s amaz—wait, what?”

[P140]
I blinked.

[P141]
*Hold on. That was supposed to be me?*

[P142]
“Um, I think there’s been some kind of misunderstanding.”

[P143]
“That’s right, my lord. There seems to have been some misunder—”

[P144]
Jin Wikyung smiled with satisfaction.

[P145]
“My youngest is modest too. Wipeng, shut your mouth.”

[P146]
“No, I’m not being modest. I think the rumor has been distorted.”

[P147]
“That’s right. I know how much you care for the Young Master, my lord, but this has gone too far. If the rumor becomes too outlandish, no one will beli—”

[P148]
“Rumor? Outlandish?”

[P149]
*BOOM!*

[P150]
Wipeng’s voice vanished beneath a thunderous crash. My mouth fell open as I stared at the gaping hole in my bedroom wall.

[P151]
*What the hell are you doing, you lunatic?*

[P152]
Jin Wikyung threw another punch. Compressed air exploded, and what remained of the wall collapsed.

[P153]
Wood and bricks poured from the two-story pavilion, sending the people outside into an uproar.

[P154]
“It’s the Third Young Master! The Third Young Master’s residence is collapsing!”

[P155]
“Get people over here! Hurry!”

[P156]
While everyone was still reeling in shock, Jin Wikyung hoisted me into the air.

[P157]
*Put me down. Put me down, you crazy bastard!*

[P158]
I struggled with all my strength, but I couldn’t fight him off. One step at a time, he carried me toward the gaping hole in the wall, and terror mounted with every step.

[P159]
*He’s going to drop me!*

[P160]
More than fifty people had gathered below. They called it a two-story building, but the pavilion was so large that we had to be a good ten meters up. The wind gusting through the hole made me dizzy.

[P161]
*If I fall, I’ll break something at the very least.*

[P162]
Even as a chill ran down my spine, more people kept crowding in. Over fifty of them craned their necks to stare up at us.

[P163]
“Who’s that? Wasn’t there an accident?”

[P164]
“Isn’t that the Lesser Family Head? Who’s he holding?”

[P165]
“The Third Young Master! It’s the Third Young Master!”

[P166]
Someone’s shout sent a stir through the crowd.

[P167]
“The Third Young Master—no, the Third Young Master, sir?”

[P168]
“The Third Young Master who defeated Jopil, One Question, One Kill, has awakened!”

[P169]
*What the hell is going on?*

[P170]
As I frantically looked around, trying to make sense of the scene, a solemn voice rang clearly in my ear.

[P171]
“Can you see them?”

[P172]
“Ah, yes. I can see them. Could you put me down—”

[P173]
“Can you hear them?”

[P174]
“I can hear them too, but first, could you—”

[P175]
“What do you feel?”

[P176]
“Embarrassment. And shame.”

[P177]
“They believe in you. They’re calling your name!”

[P178]
“You fucking bastard.”

[P179]
My final curse vanished beneath the crowd’s shouts.

[P180]
“Third Young Master! Third Young Master!”

[P181]
Dozens more people had appeared in that brief span of time. Countless gazes flew toward me and pinned me in place.

[P182]
*No, what the hell is this?*

[P183]
Then Jin Wikyung, his expression grave, slid his hands beneath my armpits and lifted me high.

[P184]
Right on cue, a thunderous cheer erupted.

[P185]
“Woooooo!”

[P186]
“Third Young Master! Jin Taekyung!”

[P187]
“Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi! Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi!”

[P188]
And then…

[P189]
*Fuck. What am I, a baby lion?*

[P190]
The theme music from an old cartoon began playing in my head.

# Translation Rules

## Fidelity

- Translate the Korean source—not the wiki, manhwa, fan translations, or expected plot.
- Semantic fidelity outranks elegance. Never improve rhythm, humor, or localization by changing a physical action, negation, relationship, hierarchy, mechanism, quantity, or causal detail.
- Preserve every fact, causal link, joke, emotional beat, repetition, and intentional omission. Add nothing.
- Preserve small action verbs and pragmatic cues exactly: nodding versus shaking one's head, pretending nothing happened, and mild or approachable impressions are characterization, not expendable texture.
- Preserve viewpoint and tense. Resolve omitted subjects only when context supports it; retain genuine ambiguity.
- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.
- Search only exact Korean terms already present in the current chapter; the compendium contains future-sensitive entries.
- Never re-romanize established names or invent grand names for uncertain terms. First use of an unlisted name or title almost always needs a footnote or a mapped ledger term.
- Use `qi` for Murim energy and `mana` for the modern Hunter system when the source distinguishes them. Preserve an established chapter-specific rendering such as `internal energy` when the exact glossary and surrounding Korean distinguish accumulated `공력` from resulting `기운`.
- In System panels, render `등급` as `**Grade:**` for quest, item, skill, and martial-art classifications. Reserve `rank` for Hunter classifications or ordinary prose; never replace a System `Grade` field with `Rank`.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.
- Keep the final file English-only reading copy: no audit notes, Korean text, summaries, or model metadata.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
- Jin Taekyung’s narration is conversational, observant, self-mocking, and occasionally profane. It may be irreverent even when the situation is serious.
- Keep deadpan punchlines short and well-timed. Do not explain a joke after delivering it.
- Preserve the source's level of explicitness. A euphemism may remain euphemistic even when its meaning is sexual or crude; do not replace it with more graphic English merely for impact.
- Make dialogue spontaneous and character-specific. Preserve hierarchy and intimacy through word choice, address, rhythm, and restraint—not archaic wuxia English.
- Use strong profanity when the Korean is strong, but neither intensify nor sanitize it. Do not make ordinary lines uniformly vulgar. Profanity should reveal mood or relationship.
- Keep action and injury vivid but clear rather than purple. Do not make violence funny unless the source’s framing does.
- Avoid stiff literalism, translator-added melodrama, dated internet slang, and quippy superhero-style banter.
- On the second pass, correct awkward English collocations and word choices without changing meaning or voice. Prefer ordinary, spoken English over stiff Latinate or ceremonial wording when the scene is brisk or comic: “goose bumps” rather than “gooseflesh,” and “laid into them” rather than “launched into a solemn denunciation.” Read the prose aloud and replace any phrase that sounds like a formal essay, legal document, or literal dictionary gloss unless the source deliberately calls for that register.

Use `[^1]` Markdown footnotes when a brief, factual, spoiler-free explanation materially helps an English reader understand:
